summary: Last week's report said the reselling failure was "one PPV away from repeating". It repeated four days later. On Aug 23 Lilia posted a screenshot and "Please sell the new red set idk why they are selling him old content" - the eighth occurrence since Jun 12, and this time the fan is almost certainly Adam West, the named premium lead she handed ALTR herself on Aug 19. Fred apologised in 53 seconds and has never reported back what he found or what changed; his Jul 24 promise to remove the offending chatter is now 35 days old, the chatter has still never been named, and there is still no purchase-history check. Vivek is worse. Ten days after she asked whether her TikTok is shadowbanned - and 28 minutes after she sent the login - she has diagnosed it herself: "I'm definitely shadowbanned on TikTok so I can't really post anything" (Aug 22). An entire acquisition channel is dead while ALTR's Meta Support Rep produces three messages and twelve words in seven days. Mayson had to @ him four separate times on Aug 23-24. Vivek asked for a login code at 12:47 on Aug 24, she answered inside a minute and re-offered at 16:31, and he has not been seen since. Fred also went quiet at the wrong moment: her Aug 26 share-for-share notice needed a Mayson escalation and was still unanswered 41 hours later at the close of the window, and her Aug 26 sexting-set repricing instruction ("have the chatter sell separately with adding photos to it so we can get more money out of the sets") got no reply at all. Meanwhile Teddi, her highest-ever spender, was announced on Aug 23 as "coming back in a couple days" at 200+ per video - and the Aug 8 commitment to prep his folder and pricing is 20 days old and never acknowledged, so he is walking back into the same unbriefed chat team that resold old content two days earlier. The one clean thread is money: the consolidated invoice went to zero with no chasing at all, Stephski confirming "Yes mam you're totaled at $0 owed now" on Aug 26. Even that has a loose end - she reported owing $192 the day before and nobody reconciled the gap. Volume halved (41 messages vs 71) and she went silent for two full days, Aug 20-22.
